query: What does Broadcom include in its reported AI semiconductor revenue
normalized: ai broadcom include reported revenue semiconductor

output.content:
Broadcom’s reported **AI semiconductor revenue** covers both the compute and connectivity hardware it sells for AI data centers—not software revenue. Specifically, its 10-K says the category includes: 

- **Custom AI accelerators / XPUs**—customer-specific accelerator ASICs for AI training and inference. 
- **AI networking silicon**—Ethernet switching and routing chips. 
- **Ethernet NICs**, plus related **physical-layer (PHY) devices** and **optical components**. 
- **XPU-based racks and systems**. [[1]] 

Broadcom’s own recent earnings language summarizes the category more narrowly as revenue driven by **custom AI accelerators and Ethernet AI switches**. [[2]] Thus, the company’s headline AI semiconductor figure is broader than custom-chip/XPU sales alone: it also includes the networking and interconnect content required to connect AI compute clusters. [[1]]

sources.title: UNITED STATES SECURITIES AND EXCHANGE COMMISSION Washington, DC 20549 Form 10-K
Broadcom Inc. Announces Fourth Quarter and Fiscal Year 2025 Financial Results and Quarterly Dividend
